query:
-- Zuerst alle Items löschen die zu RIVA-Checks gehören
DELETE pci FROM product_compliance_items pci
INNER JOIN product_compliance_checks pcc ON pci.checkId = pcc.id
WHERE pcc.supplierId = 90001;

-- Dann alle Checks löschen
DELETE FROM product_compliance_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001;

-- Auch die Website-Check-Items bereinigen (CE-Marking als not_applicable markieren)
UPDATE supplier_website_check_items 
SET status = 'not_applicable',
    finding = 'CE marking is NOT required for passive water filters (activated carbon, membrane, crystal). No electrical components, no pressure vessels above threshold. CE would only apply to UV-lamp filters or electrically-pumped RO systems.',
    criticality = 'info'
WHERE regulationCode = 'CE-Marking' 
AND checkId IN (SELECT id FROM supplier_website_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001);

-- EU-BauPVO ebenfalls korrigieren
UPDATE supplier_website_check_items 
SET status = 'not_applicable',
    finding = 'Construction Products Regulation (305/2011) does not apply to portable/under-sink water filters. No harmonised product standard exists for drinking water filters under this regulation.',
    criticality = 'info'
WHERE regulationCode = 'EU-BauPVO' 
AND checkId IN (SELECT id FROM supplier_website_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001);

SELECT COUNT(*) as deleted_checks FROM product_compliance_checks WHERE supplierId = 90001;
